title: Nvidia Board Reportedly Rules Out Jensen Huang Return Despite Growing Support Campaign
summary: Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA) is not considering reinstating former Chief Executive Jensen Huang, according to a Reuters report citing three people familiar with the matter, despite a campaign supporting his return following his resignation last week.
